hooks.command: if [ "$(git rev-parse --git-dir 2>/dev/null)" = "$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null)" ]; then mkdir -p .claude/tmp; LOCK=.claude/tmp/session.lock; OTHER=""; if [ -f "$LOCK" ]; then LPID=$(awk 'NR==1{print $1}' "$LOCK"); LTIME=$(awk 'NR==1{print $2}' "$LOCK"); NOW=$(date +%s); AGE=$((NOW - ${LTIME:-0})); if [ -n "$LPID" ] && [ "$LPID" != "$PPID" ] && [ "$AGE" -lt 43200 ] && kill -0 "$LPID" 2>/dev/null; then OTHER="$LPID"; fi; fi; echo "$PPID $(date +%s)" > "$LOCK"; if [ -n "$OTHER" ]; then echo "Note: another session (pid $OTHER) is live in this checkout right now, so working here directly risks mixing edits with theirs (the incident behind this check: two sessions once produced committed figures built against uncommitted edits). Offer to work in a worktree on a new branch (EnterWorktree) so edits do not mix, and check that the current branch ($(git branch --show-current)) fits this task before committing. Explain any git step in plain words."; else echo "Note: this is the only live session in this checkout right now. Work on main. Commit and push when a full 'bash run.sh' passes; if the push is rejected because someone else pushed first, pull, run 'bash run.sh' again, then push. Explain any git step in plain words."; fi; fi; true
